title: Skeleton Knight in Another World Anime Season 2's Video Reveals 3 Cast Members
content:
The official website for the television anime based on Ennki Hakari 's Skeleton Knight in Another World ( Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechū or Skeleton Knight, going out to the parallel universe) light novel series unveiled a new promotional video and visual for the anime's second season on Friday. The video reveals three new cast members for the anime.

The new cast members include:

• Mitsuo Iwata as Charos

• Kento Hama as Ein

• Hiroshi Naka as Hanzō

The anime will debut on the AT-X channel on July 4 at 8:30 p.m. (7:30 a.m.), and will also debut streaming on d Anime Store and ABEMA at the same time. The first episode of the second season will then have a repeat broadcast on AT-X on July 6, before running on Tokyo MX and BS11 on July 9. The anime will also air on Sun TV , but it does not yet have a premiere date on the channel.

Crunchyroll will stream the new season.

The series stars:

• Tomoaki Maeno as Arc

• Ai Fairouz as Arianne

• Nene Hieda as Ponta

• Miyu Tomita as Chiyome

• Takuya Eguchi as Danka

• Kōsuke Toriumi as Dillan

• Yūko Minaguchi as Glenys

• Rumi Ōkubo as Eevin

• Ryōta Takeuchi as Goemon

• Kengo Kawanishi as Sekt

• Daiki Hamano as Dakares

• Saori Ōnishi as Yuriarna

• Akira Ishida as Domitianus

• Minoru Shiraishi as Cetrion

• Toshihiko Seki as Villiers Fim

• Kenshō Ono as Sasuke

• Kenji Akabane as Palurumo

• Gō Shinomiya as Baltord

• Hitomi Ueda as Tsubone

• Junichi Suwabe as Thanatos

Katsumi Ono returns to direct the second season at Aura Studio . Character designer Tōru Imanishi , monster designer Yoshihiro Nagamori , and sound director Satoshi Motoyama all return for the second season.

Toshizo Nemoto ( That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime fourth season, Inu X Boku Secret Service ) is now in charge of series scripts, replacing Takeshi Kikuchi . First season sub-character designer Hideki Inoue is replaced by Chisa Shibata ( 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life , Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy ), and Jia Fang Lu ( My Clueless First Friend ) replaces art director Kenta Tsuboi . Other new staff includes color key artist Harue Ono ( MAD BOX , replacing Chiho Nakamura ), CGI director Tomotaka Aoki ( Uma Musume Pretty Derby Season 3 ), and animation producer Yasuhiro Uema . PelleK returns to perform the anime's opening theme song "Rōman Kaidō, Osanpo Chū" (Strolling on the Highway of Dreams). The voice actor unit DIALOGUE＋ performs the ending theme song "Kiseki wa Okinai" (Miracles Don't Happen).

Additional new and returning staff members include:

• Prop Design: Shinichi Miyazaki (new)

• Art Setting: Rika Mizoguchi , Manami Takizawa (new)

• Background Art: Kusanagi

• CGI Technical Director: Norimitsu Hirosawa

• Compositing Director of Photography: Satoshi Yamamoto

• Photography: Chiptune

• Editing: Yumi Jinguji (new)

• Sound Director: Satoshi Motoyama

• Sound Production: Dax Production

• Music Production: Pony Canyon

The anime's first season premiered in Japan in April 2022. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and also streams an English dub .

Seven Seas Entertainment is publishing the light novel series and its manga adaptation in English, and it describes the story:

One day, a gamer played video games until he fell asleep…and when he woke up, he found himself in the game world–as a skeleton! Equipped with the powerful weapons and armor of his avatar but stuck with its frightening skeletal appearance, Arc has to find a place for himself in this new, fantastical land. All his hopes for a quiet life are dashed when he crosses paths with a beautiful elven warrior, setting him on a journey full of conflict and adventure.

Ennki Hakari launched the novels on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's be Novelists) website in October 2014. Overlap published the first volume with illustrations by KeG in June 2015, and the 10th volume in March 2022. Seven Seas shipped the 10th volume in April 2023.

Akira Sawano ( A Bridge to the Starry Skies character design) launched the ongoing manga adaptation on Overlap 's Comic Gardo website in February 2017. Overlap shipped the 15th volume on June 20, and Seven Seas shipped the 14th volume on March 24.
author: ANN

title: 'Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu II' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo
content:
The official website for the Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu ( Skeleton Knight in Another World ) television anime revealed additional cast, a second promotional video, and a key visual (pictured) for the second season on Thursday. The second season adapting Ennki Hakari 's action fantasy light novel will begin airing on July 6 at 10:00 p.m. on AT-X, followed by Tokyo MX, and BS11.

Cast Charos: Mitsuo Iwata ( MF Ghost ) Ein: Kento Hama ( Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru ) Hanzou: Hiroshi Naka ( Dungeon Meshi )

Katsumi Ono ( A-Rank Party wo Ridatsu shita Ore wa, Moto Oshiego-tachi to Meikyuu Shinbu wo Mezasu. ) is helming the second season at Aura Studio . Toshizou Nemoto ( Log Horizon ) is handling the series composition. Tooru Imanishi ( Shuumatsu Nani Shitemasu ka? Isogashii desu ka? Sukutte Moratte Ii desu ka? ) is designing the characters, and Eba ( Dead Mount Death Play ) and Tsubasa Itou ( Kaiko sareta Ankoku Heishi (30-dai) no Slow na Second Life ) are composing the music.

Produced by Studio KAI and HORNETS , the first season aired in 12 episodes in Spring 2022. Crunchyroll streamed the anime with subtitles in multiple languages and English dub.

Hakari began penning the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in October 2014. Overlap began publishing the novel with illustrations by KeG in June 2015 and published the tenth volume in March 2022. Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu has a cumulative 3.5 million copies of its volumes in circulation, including digital editions.

Akira Sawano began drawing a manga adaptation on Overlap's Comic Gardo web manga portal in February 2017. The 15th volume went on sale on June 20.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed both light novel and manga in English in September 2018 and published the tenth novel volume in April 2023. The 14th manga volume went on sale on March 24.

PV 2

title: 'Mao' Reveals Additional Cast, Opening Theme for Second Cour
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Rumiko Takahashi 's Mao manga revealed additional cast, a second key visual (pictured right), and the opening theme for second cour on Friday. The anime series premiered on April 4 at 11:45 p.m. on NHK G.

Cast Hakubi: Takuya Satou ( Yuukoku no Moriarty ) Natsuno: Rie Kugimiya ( Gintama ) Daigo: Katsuyuki Konishi ( Kimetsu no Yaiba ) Souma Kagami: Tasuku Kaito ( Blue Lock ) Kagari Houshou: Shino Shimoji ( Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha, Isekai Kizoku ni Tensei suru )

Boy group 20th Century will perform the opening theme for second cour "Bokura ga Uwagaki suru Sekai."

Teruo Satou ( Hanyou no Yashahime: Sengoku Otogizoushi ) is directing the anime at Sunrise , with Yuuko Kakihara ( Urusei Yatsura (2022) ) handling the series composition. Yoshihito Hishinuma ( InuYasha ) is designing the characters and chief animation director. Shuu Kanematsu ( Hametsu no Oukoku ) is composing the music.

Takahashi began serializing the supernatural manga in Weekly Shounen Sunday magazine in May 2019. Shogakukan published the 29th volume on June 18.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in February 2021. The 24th volume shipped on May 12, with the 25th volume planned for an August 11 release.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The World's Strongest Witch Anime's New Video Reveals 2 Cast Members
content:
The official website for the television anime of Mochimaru Sakaki 's The World's Strongest Witch: I'm Starting My Free Life in a World Where Only I Can See the Online Strategy Guide ( Sekai Saikyō no Majo, Hajimemashita: Watashi dake "Kōryaku Site" o Mireru Sekai de Jiyū ni Ikimasu ) light novel series began streaming a promotional video for the anime on Friday. The video reveals two cast members for the anime.

Fairouz Ai as Erimina, the master of the adverturers' guild known as the "Inferno Witch"

Honoka Inoue as Eruna, an elff princess who worries over her sick mother

Azusa Tachibana was previously announced as voicing protagonist Rona Hermit.

Yen Press is releasing the light novels in English, and released the second volume on April 14. Yen Press describes the story:

When Lorna manifests a completely useless ability, she's labeled an embarrassment to her family and kicked out of the house. With no money or food, she's about to hit rock bottom. But then, she figures out how to use her supposedly worthless SSS-Rank skill, “Internet.” This cheat-level talent gives her the know-how to gather an unlimited amount of valuable items and easily acquire rare equipment. Armed with godlike knowledge, Lorna's free to do anything she wants! If only she could figure out what “lmfao” means…

Jōji Furuta ( ēlDLIVE , Double Decker! Doug & Kirill , Bad Girl ) is directing the anime at the studios Bridge and Aisle . Shoji Yonemura ( Pokémon Journeys: The Series , One Piece 2013-onwards, Bad Girl ) is in charge of the series scripts. Yūki Morimoto ( Cardfight!! Vanguard GZ , Boarding School Juliet , Bad Girl ) is designing the characters.

The anime will premiere in October.

Mochimaru Sakaki began serializing the original story in the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in May 2022. Square Enix published the first print novel volume in December 2022, with illustrations by riritto . The fifth novel volume shipped in May 2025.

Tamaki Toga launched a manga adaptation in Kodansha 's Getsu Maga Kichi/ Comic Days website in May 2023. Kodansha published the manga's 12th compiled book volume on May 8.

Comikey publishes both Daisuke Takashima 's manga adaptation of Sakaki's The Strongest Swordsman Has Zero Equipment Slots novel series, as well as Namiki Tsukiyama 's manga adaptation of Sakaki's Final Boss Fake-out novel series in English. Square Enix also publishes both manga in English on its Manga UP! Global website.
author: ANN

title: Skeleton Knight in Another World Season 2 Reveals Second Trailer, New Key Visual
content:
Skeleton Knight in Another World Season 2 anime revealed a new visual and trailer featuring the ED song ahead of its July 6 premiere. The anime previously confirmed that Aura Studio would be replacing Studio KAI and HORNETS for the animation production, with Katsumi Ono is returning as director. DIALOGUE+ was previously confirmed to be returning to perform the ending song “Kiseki wa Okinai” (“Miracles Won’t Happen”) after also being in charge of the Season 1 ED. You can watch the new trailer below.

Also check out the full new visual:

Studios Kai and HORNETS animated the first season of Skeleton Knight in Another World , which ran for 12 episodes from April 7 to June 23, 2022. It was directed by Katsumi Ono, with script by Takeshi Kikuchi, character designs by Toru Imanishi, and music by eba and Tsubasa Ito. The voice cast includes:

• Tomoaki Maeno as Arc

• Ai Fairouz as Arianne

• Nene Hieda as Ponta

• Miyu Tomita as Chiyome

• Takuya Eguchi as Danka

• Kohsuke Toriumi as Dillan

• Yuko Minaguchi as Glenys

• Rumi Okubo as Eevin

• Ryota Takeuchi as Goemon

Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the original Japanese light novel by Ennki Hakari (story) and KeG (art) in English, while Crunchyroll streams the anime. The story follows Arc, a player who gets transported into the body of his MMO game character. Now he is a Skeleton Knight, and he works as a mercenary to avoid being seen as a monster and taken out.
author: Anime Corner

title: One Punch Man Season 3 Teases Cour 2 With Updated Key Visual Featuring New Characters
content:
One Punch Man Season 3 revealed an updated key visual for its Cour 2, featuring some new characters who will be appearing. Studio J.C Staff is in charge of the animation, and the second part was previously confirmed for a 2027 release .

You can see the new visual below.

You can compare the visuals with their Cour 1 versions below.

One Punch Man was created by ONE as a webcomic manga in 2009. It got a digital manga remake with art by Yusuke Murata in June 2012. The manga is serialized on Shueisha’s Tonari no Young Jump website, while Viz Media licensed it in English and is serializing it in Weekly Shonen Jump . Studio MADHOUSE animated the breakout first season, which aired from October to December 2015. Studio J.C. Staff took over for season 2, which aired from April to July 2019. The 3rd season was announced in August last year. 2025 marked the 10th anniversary of the anime .

The story follows Saitama, a man who became a hero for fun. He had his famous daily training regime for 3 years (100 pushups, 100 squats, 100 situps, 10km run), which got him so overpowered that he could take any opponent down with a single punch. Besides all the major villains or evildoers, Saitama also meets a bunch of quirky heroes from the Hero Association and is constantly getting underestimated while being the one to actually protect humanity. The third season focuses on the ‘Hero Hunter’ Garo .
author: Anime Corner

title: Aoashi Season 2 Reveals Main Visual, Theme Songs, Anime Expo Panel Ahead of October Premiere
content:
The upcoming second season of AOASHI has unveiled its first cour main key visual, opening and ending theme artists, and new comments from the main cast ahead of its October 2026 premiere. Studio TMS Entertainment was previously confirmed to be taking over from Production I.G for the animation production. The soccer anime will also host a panel at Anime Expo 2026, where fans will get the first look at new footage from the series.

The new visual features Ashito Aoi alongside the Tokyo City Esperion Youth A Team, including Nagisa Akutsu, Haruhisa Kuribayashi, Yuma Motoki, Taira Nakamura, Yoichi Kiriki, Eita Takasugi, and Enshin Akiyama, following Ashito’s promotion to the club’s top youth squad. According to the press release, the first cour will cover the opening 12 episodes of the season’s planned 24-episode run.

Season 2’s opening theme will be performed by Japanese rock band 10-FEET, while singer-songwriter Ai Higuchi will perform the ending theme.

Three cast members also shared short previews of what fans can expect from their characters this season:

• Koki Osuzu (Ashito Aoi): “Soccer at a level even closer to the pros!!”

• Shunsuke Takeuchi (Nagisa Akutsu): “Keep your eyes on that slick buzz cut!!”

• Yuichiro Umehara (Haruhisa Kuribayashi): “Anguish.”

You can see the new visual below.

The series will appear at Anime Expo 2026 with a panel titled “AOASHI Panel: Changing the Game of Sports Anime!” on July 3 from 10:00 a.m. to 10:50 a.m. PT in Room 408AB at the Los Angeles Convention Center. Producer Junichi Katsutani will present a behind-the-scenes look at the anime, including a world premiere preview of Season 2 footage and a discussion of how the production approaches realistic soccer animation. The panel will be hosted by Gigguk, alongside anime and manga creator Jay D. Legend, and will also feature giveaways, fan activities, and a special announcement.

Aoashi (stylized AO ASHI ) by Yugo Kobayashi began in January 2015 and was serialized in Shogakukan’s Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine. The manga recently exceeded 20 million circulating copies and ended with 40 volumes . The first season by Production I.G ran for 22 episodes from April to September 2022. Crunchyroll is streaming it, describing the story: After a loss in his last junior high school soccer tourney, Ehime Prefecture’s ace player, Ashito Aoi, is devastated but in every loss there’s a victory. Tatsuya Fukuda, manager of an organization that trains students for one of the leading clubs in the J-League, sees Ashito’s raw talent and offers a tryout to his group. Together they’ll bring the youth club and Aoshi’s talents to new heights!
author: Anime Corner

The soccer anime will also host a panel at Anime Expo 2026, where fans will get the first look at new footage from the series.

The new visual features Ashito Aoi alongside the Tokyo City Esperion Youth A Team, including Nagisa Akutsu, Haruhisa Kuribayashi, Yuma Motoki, Taira Nakamura, Yoichi Kiriki, Eita Takasugi, and Enshin Akiyama, following Ashito’s promotion to the club’s top youth squad. According to the press release, the first cour will cover the opening 12 episodes of the season’s planned 24-episode run.
Season 2’s opening theme will be performed by Japanese rock band 10-FEET, while singer-songwriter Ai Higuchi will perform the ending theme.
Three cast members also shared short previews of what fans can expect from their characters this season:
Koki Osuzu (Ashito Aoi): “Soccer at a level even closer to the pros!!”
Shunsuke Takeuchi (Nagisa Akutsu): “Keep your eyes on that slick buzz cut!!”
Yuichiro Umehara (Haruhisa Kuribayashi): “Anguish.”
You can see the new visual below.

contentBlocks.caption: aoashi season 2 main visual first cour

contentBlocks.text: The series will appear at Anime Expo 2026 with a panel titled “AOASHI Panel: Changing the Game of Sports Anime!” on July 3 from 10:00 a.m. to 10:50 a.m. PT in Room 408AB at the Los Angeles Convention Center. Producer Junichi Katsutani will present a behind-the-scenes look at the anime, including a world premiere preview of Season 2 footage and a discussion of how the production approaches realistic soccer animation. The panel will be hosted by Gigguk, alongside anime and manga creator Jay D. Legend, and will also feature giveaways, fan activities, and a special announcement.

Aoashi (stylized AO ASHI ) by Yugo Kobayashi began in January 2015 and was serialized in Shogakukan’s Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine. The manga recently exceeded 20 million circulating copies and ended with 40 volumes . The first season by Production I.G ran for 22 episodes from April to September 2022. Crunchyroll is streaming it, describing the story: After a loss in his last junior high school soccer tourney, Ehime Prefecture’s ace player, Ashito Aoi, is devastated but in every loss there’s a victory. Tatsuya Fukuda, manager of an organization that trains students for one of the leading clubs in the J-League, sees Ashito’s raw talent and offers a tryout to his group. Together they’ll bring the youth club and Aoshi’s talents to new heights!

title: MAO Anime Announces More Cast for 2nd Part
content:
The official website for Sunrise 's television anime based on the MAO manga by Rumiko Takahashi unveiled a new visual and more cast members for the anime's second part on Friday.

The new cast members include:

Takuya Satō as Hakubi, an onmyōji of metal and MAO 's former fellow disciple

Rie Kugimiya as Natsuno, an onmyōji of earth and MAO 's former fellow disciple

Katsuyuki Konishi as Daigo, an onmyōji of earth and MAO 's former fellow disciple

Tasuku Kaito as Soma Kagami, the second son of the Kagami family

Shino Shimoji as Kagari Hosho, the daughter of the Kagami family

In addition, the site revealed a new visual of Yurako (seen below), who is voiced by Reina Ueda .

The site also streamed the clean version of the second half's opening credits sequence, which features the opening theme song "Bokura ga Uwagaki suru Sekai" (The World We Overwrite) by the boy group 20th Century .

The second cours of the MAO anime will start with its 14th episode on July 4.

The anime debuted on April 4 on the NHK -General channel on April 4 at 11:45 p.m. (10:45 a.m. EST) and will run for two continuous cours without breaks. Hulu is streaming the anime in U.S., and on Disney+ in Canada, Latin America, Australia, and New Zealand.

The cast members are:

• Yūki Kaji as MAO

• Natsumi Kawaida as Nanoka Kiba

• Hiro Shimono as Hyakka

• Toshiyuki Toyonaga as Kamon

• Momoka Terasawa as Otoya

• Kazuyuki Okitsu as Shiranui

• Motoko Kumai as Funa Uozumi

• Yōko Hikasa as Tenko

• Risa Shimizu as Sana

• Reina Ueda as Yurako

• Takashi Matsuyama as Byōki

The staff members are:

• Director: Teruo Sato (Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon, Aikatsu Stars!)

• Series Script Supervisor: Yūko Kakihara (2022 Urusei Yatsura, Aikatsu Friends!, Cells at Work!)

• Character Designer, Chief Animation Director: Yoshihito Hishinuma (InuYasha, Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon)

• Art Director: Hiroshi Katō, Izumi Hoki

• Color Key Artist: Masumi Ōtsuka

• CG Director: Tomohiro Fujie

• Compositing Director of Photography: Akane Fushihara

• Editing: Kazuhiro Nii

• Sound Director: Hiromi Kikuta

• Music: Shū Kanematsu (The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses, My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom!)

Boy band Kis-My-Ft2 performs the first opening theme song "HEARTLOUD," and TRUE performs the ending theme song "Juai" (Cursed Love).

Viz publishes the manga in English, and it describes the "era-spanning supernatural adventure" story:

When Nanoka travels back in time to a supernatural early 20th Century , she gets recruited by aloof exorcist MAO . What is the thread of fate that connects them? Together, they seek answers...and kick some demon butt along the way! Nanoka passes through a portal into the Taisho era, where exorcist MAO reluctantly rescues her from the jaws of a grotesque yokai. When Nanoka gets back to the present, she discovers she has some new, incredible abilities. She returns to the past looking for answers, only to get caught up in MAO 's investigation of a series of gruesome murders. As her questions about herself multiply, Nanoka learns that MAO is cursed by a cat demon named Byoki—and so is his sword. If anyone but MAO attempts to wield it, they are doomed. But when MAO 's life is in jeopardy, Nanoka picks up his blade and swings!

Takahashi launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine in May 2019. Shogakukan published the 29th compiled book volume on June 18. Viz began publishing the manga in 2021.

In her career of over three decades, Takahashi has created manga such as Urusei Yatsura , Maison Ikkoku , Mermaid Saga , Rumic Theater , Ranma 1/2 , One-Pound Gospel , and InuYasha . Many of her works have become internationally popular and inspired anime and live-action adaptations.
author: ANN

title: 'Sekai Saikyou no Majo, Hajimemashita' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, Character Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Mochimaru Sakaki 's Sekai Saikyou no Majo, Hajimemashita: Watashi dake "Kouryaku Site" wo Mireru Sekai de Jiyuu ni Ikimasu ( The World's Strongest Witch: I'm Starting My Free Life in a World Where Only I Can See the Online Strategy Guide ) light novel revealed a pair of additional cast and character promotional video on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere in October 2026.

Voice actresses Fairouz Ai ( Chainsaw Man ) and Honoka Inoue ( Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku ) are joining the cast as Elimina Manaflame and Erna, respectively.

Jouji Furuta ( Shaman King (2021), Nanatsu no Taizai: Imashime no Fukkatsu ) is directing the anime at Bridge and Aisle . Shouji Yonemura ( Hotel Inhumans , Kiseijuu: Sei no Kakuritsu ) is handling the series composition. Yuuki Morimoto ( Bad Girl , Miss Monochrome The Animation ) is designing the characters.

Sakaki began penning the fantasy adventure series on both the Shousetsuka ni Narou and Kakuyomu websites simultaneously in May 2022. Square Enix began publishing the novel through its SQEX Novel imprint in December 2022, featuring illustrations by riritto . The fifth volume went on sale in May 2025.

Tamaki Toga began drawing a manga adaptation in Getsumaga Kichi magazine in May 2023. The 12th volume was released on May 8.

Yen Press licensed the light novel in English in May 2025, and published the second volume on April 14. The third volume is scheduled to go on sale on Novemver 10.

title: Kagurabachi to Stream on Crunchyroll Worldwide, Katsuyuki Konishi Joins Cast as Togo Shiba
content:
KAGURABACHI anime will officially stream on Crunchyroll worldwide, with Katsuyuki Konishi joining the voice cast as Togo Shiba. The highly anticipated anime is set to premiere in April 2027, while it will have its world premiere next month during Anime Expo 2026. Crunchyroll will stream the anime globally, excluding Japan, Mainland China, North Korea, and South Korea.

Studio Cypic is in charge of the animation production, with Tetsuya Takeuchi as the director. Takeuchi is famously known for the Rock Lee vs Gaara fight in Naruto. We previously also had the chance to interview CyberAgent’s Takahiro Yamauchi , who talked about the company and its goal of creating “ high-quality Japanese animation works that can be accepted globally .”

The main staff for the anime includes:

• Director: Tetsuya Takeuchi

• Character Design: Keigo Sasaki

• Production: Cypic

Previously, the anime revealed the following voice cast:

• Taihi Kimura as Chihiro Rokuhira

• Tomokazu Seki as Kunishige Rokuhira

Some of Konishi’s most popular roles include those of Tengei Uzui in Demon Slayer , Enjin in Gachiakuta , Kamina in Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann , Diavolo in JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure , among many others. You can see his new character below.

The story follows the young Chihiro, who was trained by his father to become a swordsmith. After his father is murderer, Chihiro sets on a path of revenge to avenge him with yakuza and sorcerers standing against him. The official synopsis:

Flames of resolve, kindled by hatred. Chihiro Rokuhira is a boy who aspires to become a swordsmith, and took daily training under his father Kunishige, a renowned swordsmith. Their days, once filled with laughter, are brutally torn apart by an attack from the mysterious sorcerer organization, the Hishaku. What is stolen from them are the six Enchanted Blades—swords of immense power capable of shaping the fate of the nation—and the gentle, warm life they once shared. From that day on, everything changed. In a world engulfed in darkness, Chihiro takes up Enten, the seventh Enchanted Blade left behind by his father, and sets out on a blood-soaked path of revenge.

The first teaser trailer for the anime exceeded 6 million views within the first 24 hours, and you can check it out below.
